mentions.name: LLM MUD-style world sim
mentions.description: A tiny MUD-style world simulation sandbox where LLMs control each character. Agents take actions, pray to the creator of their world, and can receive responses in a separate cycle, with a few simple rules leading to emergent storytelling. It's a goalless toy, like a more advanced Tamagotchi.
mentions.problem: LLM agents kept repeating a small set of actions and rarely tried experimental ones; prompt tweaking helped them branch out, but instilling a creative spark for exploration through prompting remains unsolved, and there isn't enough compute to run larger experiments with many seed worlds.
mentions.source_excerpt: I vibe coded a tiny MUD-style world sim where LLMs control each character. It's basically a little toy sandbox where LLMs can play around. There's no real goal to this, I just thought that it would be fun, like a more advanced tamagochi.
